description: Lists the amendments tabled at one stage of a UK bill, with the clause or schedule targeted, the amendment wording, its sponsors and the decision recorded (agreed, negatived, withdrawn, not moved). For public affairs teams and campaigners tracking whether an amendment got through. Source: UK Parliament Bills API. Needs the bill ID and a stage_id from bill_stages_timeline; can filter by decision or a word in the amendment, and pages with skip. Decisions are null until Parliament records them. (cost: 1 credit)

billId.description: integer, required, the Parliament bill ID, e.g. 4035

billStageId.description: integer, required, the stage_id from bill_stages_timeline, e.g. 21180

decision.description: string, optional, only amendments with this recorded decision: agreed, agreed_on_division, withdrawn, withdrawn_before_debate, disagreed, negatived_on_division, not_moved, not_selected, not_called, no_decision, question_proposed, stood_part, not_stood_part, preempted; default all

search.description: string, optional, word or phrase in the amendment text, e.g. ombudsman

skip.description: integer, optional, amendments to skip for paging, 0-100000, default 0

take.description: integer, optional, amendments to return 1-100, default 25

name: bill_amendments
